paper.title_en: Regular/Singular Black Hole Thermodynamics from Renormalised Volume/Area
paper.abstract_en: We study the finite mismatch between the holographically and topologically renormalised Euclidean actions of the four-dimensional AdS C-metric. Starting from the relation between Renormalised Volume and the Einstein sector of Conformal Gravity, we separate the regular curvature contribution from the contributions supported on the two conical axes. After introducing the usual Euler normalisation for smooth manifolds, the residual difference between the regular action evaluations is determined by the tension-weighted Euler terms of the renormalised worldsheet area. We identify this difference with the Gauss--Bonnet entropy contribution at the polar conical points of the horizon. The ordinary Euler characteristic remains fixed, while the deficits determine how its curvature representation is divided between regular and singular contributions. At fixed total string tension, the difference of the renormalised worldsheet areas per unit Euclidean time determines the relative tension work, giving a geometric interpretation of the relative thermodynamic length.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在AdS C-度规的欧几里得作用量框架下研究正则/奇异黑洞热力学，将重整化体积与面积之差同锥形轴上的Gauss--Bonnet熵贡献联系起来，属于黑洞热力学与修正引力的交叉问题，理论深度较高，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 由重整化体积/面积得到的正则/奇异黑洞热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四维 AdS C-度规的全息重整化欧几里得作用量与拓扑重整化欧几里得作用量之间的有限失配。从重整化体积与共形引力爱因斯坦扇区之间的关系出发，我们将正则曲率贡献与支撑在两条锥形轴上的贡献分离开来。在引入光滑流形的通常欧拉归一化之后，正则作用量赋值之间的残余差异由重整化世界面面积的张力加权欧拉项决定。我们将这一差异认定为视界极向锥点处的 Gauss--Bonnet 熵贡献。普通的欧拉示性数保持固定，而亏损角决定了其曲率表示如何被分配到正则贡献与奇异贡献之间。在总弦张力固定时，每单位欧几里得时间重整化世界面面积之差决定了相对的张力功，从而为相对热力学长度给出了几何解释。
